# cozystack_clickhouse (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack ClickHouse instance by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_clickhouse" "analytics" {
  name      = "analytics"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) ClickHouse instance name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `log_storage_size` (String) Persistent volume size for logs.
- `log_ttl` (Number) Log retention in days.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas per shard.
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU and memory per replica, when set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `resources_preset` (String) Sizing preset.
- `shards` (Number) Number of shards.
- `size` (String) Persistent volume size for data.
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass used to store the data.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).
- `users` (Attributes Map) ClickHouse users keyed by user name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU available to each replica.
- `memory` (String) Memory available to each replica.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the user is read-only.
